settings.title: Settings
settings.enableManualInpaintingDesc: For erase model, click a button to trigger inpainting after draw mask.
settings.enableDownloadMaskDesc: Also download the mask after save the inpainting result.
settings.enableAutoExtractPromptDesc: Automatically extract prompt/negativate prompt from the image meta.

diffusion.cropperTip: Inpainting on part of image, improve inference speed and reduce memory usage.
diffusion.brushnetTip: BrushNet is a plug-and-play image inpainting model works on any SD1.5 base models.
diffusion.controlnetTip: Using an additional conditioning image to control how an image is generated
diffusion.lcmLoraTip: Enable quality image generation in typically 2-8 steps. Suggest disabling guidance_scale by setting it to 0. You can also try values between 1.0 and 2.0. When LCM Lora is enabled, LCMSampler will be used automatically.
diffusion.negativePromptTip: Negative prompt guides the model away from generating certain things in an image
diffusion.exampleImageTip: An example image to guide image generation.
diffusion.imageGuidanceScaleTip: Push the generated image towards the inital image. Higher image guidance scale encourages generated images that are closely linked to the source image, usually at the expense of lower image quality.
diffusion.strengthTip: Strength is a measure of how much noise is added to the base image, which influences how similar the output is to the base image. Higher value means more noise and more different from the base image
diffusion.extenderTip: Perform outpainting on images to expand it's content.
diffusion.taskTip: PowerPaint task. When using extender, image-outpainting task will be auto used. For object-removal and image-outpainting, it is recommended to set the guidance_scale at 10 or above.
diffusion.powerpaintV2Tip: PowerPaint is a plug-and-play image inpainting model works on any SD1.5 base models.
diffusion.stepsTip: The number of denoising steps. More denoising steps usually lead to a higher quality image at the expense of slower inference.
diffusion.guidanceTip: Guidance scale affects how aligned the text prompt and generated image are. Higher value means the prompt and generated image are closely aligned, so the output is a stricter interpretation of the prompt
diffusion.seedTip: Using same parameters and a fixed seed can generate same result image.
diffusion.matchHistogramsTip: Match the inpainting result histogram to the source image histogram
diffusion.maskOpTip: Expand or shrink mask. Using the slider to adjust the kernel size for dilation or erosion.
